description: minimumReleaseAge and ignorePaths: Renovate is this repo's only version bot since 2026-10-16 (Dependabot version updates removed; security alerts stay on). minimumReleaseAge keeps the 7-day hold Dependabot's cooldown gave, because a freshly published release is the prime window for a compromised package. ignorePaths is config:recommended's list minus **/examples/**, so the examples/* apps Dependabot covered stay covered. The root package.json override vitepress > vite > esbuild (^0.25) is deliberate: it keeps the root's esbuild ^0.28 security floor away from vitepress's vite 6, which the docs lockfile always ran on esbuild 0.25. Drop it once vitepress moves to a vite that accepts esbuild 0.28.

packageRules.description: Hold @types/node to the Node major CI runs (24.x in .github/workflows/main.yml). Types for a newer major describe APIs the runtime lacks, so code type-checks and then fails at run time. Raise this bound in the same commit that moves CI's node-version.
